title: Model change certification & temporal signoff flow for canaries, shadow, and A/B
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement a temporal signoff and certification flow for model promotions that covers canary rollouts, A/B tests, and shadow traffic. Deliverables: policy-driven approval windows, expirable delegated signoffs, RBAC enforcement, structured audit artifacts, and integration with auto-rollback triggers.
background: As Redwood scales Dedicated and Private customers, product teams require auditable, timeboxed approvals for production model changes. Existing ad-hoc signoffs cause delays and inconsistent evidence for audits. This ticket consolidates requirements for temporal/expiring signoffs usable across canaries, A/B lanes, and shadow experiments.
goals: Create a reusable approval artifact that records signatories, rationale, evidence links, and expiry
Add RBAC mapping so only authorized roles can approve specified change classes
Emit structured audit logs for compliance and post-mortems
Support automation: when rollout SLOs breach, trigger auto-rollback while preserving approval evidence
scope: Approval workflows and change management surface + APIs; console UI for signoff creation and expiry; audit log schema; integration with rollout controller for auto-rollback. Does NOT include identity provider changes or full SSO implementation.
out_of_scope: Implementing new SSO providers, encryption-at-rest changes, or retrofitting old rollouts to the new schema.
proposed_design: 1) Approval artifact: JSON document stored in the control plane (immutable once signed) with fields: change_key, model_version, rollout_type, signatories (role,name,email,timestamp), evidence_urls, expiry_ts, risk_score, linked_canary_metrics_dashboard_url. 2) RBAC rules: declarative mapping that allows role-based delegation and time-limited delegation tokens. 3) Console flow: create signoff -> attach evidence -> request approvals -> reviewers approve/decline -> artifact issued and attached to rollout. 4) Rollout controller consults approval artifact and enforces expiry: if artifact expired and rollout still in progress, pause and require re-authorization.
rbac_matrix: Owners: model-service-admins (approve P0/legacy model swaps); Approvers: SRE, Product Security, Data Privacy for high-impact; Delegates: Team leads with expirable tokens limited to 48 hours; Auto-approvals: None except for low-impact config flips defined by policy.
audit_log_requirements: Each approval artifact emits a single line structured event: {artifact_id, change_key, signer, role, outcome, timestamp, evidence_refs, expiry_ts, correlation_id}
All events written to immutable audit index with retention selector for enterprise audits
Create view in observability console for signoff lifecycle and anomalies
rollout_flow: Initiate rollout in Console or API (specify lane: canary/ab/shadow)
System suggests required approvers based on impact policy (risk score + customer flags)
Requester attaches evidence (eval results, canary test plan, performance dashboards)
Approvers sign via Console or approve API; artifact issued with expiry window (default 72h)
Rollout controller reads artifact and proceeds. If artifact expiry < expected rollout duration, controller will pause before expiry and emit reauthorization event
If SLO breach detected during rollout, auto-rollback triggers immediately and audit artifact is updated with rollback_reason and timeline
approval_expiry_policy: Default expiry = 72 hours. For P0 or enterprise high-impact changes, max expiry = 24 hours and require at least two approvers. Delegated signoffs may be issued for 12-48 hours and are recorded with delegate_id and scope.
auto_rollback_triggers: Latency p50/p95 above configured threshold for 10 minutes
Error rate spike > X% over baseline for 5 minutes
Quality regression score drop on critical evaluation prompts beyond tolerance
ui_changes: Signoff composer in Console: template fields, upload evidence, automated impact calc
Signoff timeline and status badges on rollout detail pages
Reauthorization prompt and fast-path request for additional signers
Audit view filtered by model, team, or time window
acceptance_criteria: Console: create signoff, attach evidence, collect approvals, artifact emitted and linked to rollout
API: create_signoff and approve_signoff endpoints implemented with RBAC checks
Audit: structured events appear in audit index and can be queried by correlation_id
Rollback: when configured SLOs breach, rollout controller performs rollback and audit artifact references rollback event
Expiry: signoff expiry pauses active rollout and requires explicit reauthorization
